target.cover_file: cells.json (filter detector == CUSUM FIRST; index collides with SR)

tail_adjacent_quarantine.rule: Self-imposed, stricter than the campaign prompt, following ROUTE_AUDIT_R1 section 8 ('calibration on any real cell' is load-bearing because per-cell ratios transfer as estimates, E09). No NEW-ROUTE quantity (new bound, new constant, improvement ratio) is computed on cell 305 tonight. Reading committed 305 values is allowed.

forbidden_evaluation_classes: Gamma / g_hi + rho*x*M / C5-T clause value for any target cell under ANY supply, including re-computation of historical sealed values by code execution

any enclosure radius rad_r, half_r, H_k, M_k, magnitude, margin, pass/fail indicator, x-eff factor, critical constant or critical ratio for a target cell under any new route, supply, theorem, cover, truncation, tolerance or consumer

any new-route input quantity computed ON a target cell: new operator constants (C_T, tau, Abar, D_lo, D1, D2, A0, A1, A2), new sup norms, new sigma3/sigma4, new residual bounds, new cover cells, new order-3 objects
mixed-supply evaluation (I1 and I2 constants combined), including per-constant attribution of the sealed 306 Gamma gap by partial substitution
perturbation / sensitivity sweeps evaluated at target cells
any number designed or able to reveal the sign of a quarantined target outcome under a new route (target-equivalent proxy)
any optimisation, search or tuning whose objective involves a target cell
forbidden_executions: any historical campaign driver or CLI entry point (c2_d5_forecast, tail_forecast_r2, tct_inputs replay, c12*/c12r1*/c12r2* drivers, c11r_runs/c11r_launch/c11r_compare, c11rd runs, taboo_certify on any target block, c2_refined_registry build, closeout checkers)
any exactly-once protocol step of any campaign (qualification, grant, execution, seal, comparison, adjudication)
remote hosts (AWS, Vultr): not contacted tonight
allowed: reading committed text and JSON, including historical target values (Gamma, terms, factors) exactly as committed
arithmetic on committed historical intermediate values under the historically evaluated supply only (no mixing, no perturbation), each logged in the ledger as HISTORICAL_DECOMPOSITION
symbolic / exact-rational derivation, theorem statements and proofs
new stdlib-only code exercised on synthetic fixtures, analytically solvable cases, and real non-tail cells (other m values, lower front) for soundness only
improvement ratios on synthetic fixtures and non-tail cells only

enforcement.runtime_guard: code/ov_quarantine.py: every new route entry point calls guard_cell(detector, m, cell) and refuses target and tail-adjacent cells
enforcement.static_scan: code/ov_quarantine.py --scan: AST/regex scan of all new code for target-cell literals used as data, imports of historical consumer/driver modules, and reads of target-cell input files; must show coverage (files scanned) and pass a planted negative control
enforcement.ledger: ledger/ZERO_TARGET_LEDGER.jsonl: one line per potentially sensitive execution
enforcement.stop_rule: any target leak STOPS the affected route immediately; it is classified INVALID_RESULT_CHASING or LEAKED and cannot be rescued tonight (G1/G7/G8)
